newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended firm but off best levels, with the long end coming under some pressure as swap rates rose.
Rising swap rates left bonds expensive relative to swaps. This in turn reduces demand from professionals, traders said. Overall business was quiet and thin.

On Monday the September contracts took over as most active on the Swiss futures exchange Soffex. June settled up 22 at 122.17. New issues remained slack. Credit Suisse increased an outstanding perpetual issue to 450 million Swiss francs from 350 million.
Conf futures CONFU7 up three at 120.68.
Comi medium-term bond COMIU7 settles up four at 113.50
Euro Swiss francs FESU7 down four at 98.54.
